text.text_excerpt: Well, we actually found a place on Bourbon St. that we liked! Went to the Funky PIrate 3 times during our honeymoon stay. They have some amazing jazz/blues bands playing here - it's worth spending a few hours rocking out to them. No food to speak of, but the bartenders and waitstaff are amazing - they are so fast and accurate. Two nights, we had the same waitress and she remembered us and always made sure we didn't need anything. Saw Big Al twice and he is one talented dude as is his band. They have hand grenades but I stayed away from that and just got vodka tonics and shots.

Funky Pirate was definitely my favorite spot on my recent visit to NOLA. It seems that while many Bourbon Street spots are favoring top 40 cover bands, this establishment has held true to the blues/jazz roots. As other reviewers have mentioned, Big Al and the Blues Masters are kickass. We hd so much fun watching them perform that we went back every night. Big Al is such an awesome performer, and I would highly suggest anyone visiting NOLA to go check him out! Funky Pirate has no cover, but they do enforce the one drink upon entry, one per set rule...but seriously, I don't think that is a hardship on Bourbon Street. We were in NOLA for a week- stopped in here a few times. My hubby loved this bar because the music was good, the drinks were reasonably. As with all bars the crowd and the acts make or break your experience. I loved this place the first night when another bank was playing & the crowed was a fun group....we came back when Big AL was playing & though it was good...the crowd wasn't as much fun...all in all a good place to get out of the Bourbon Street chaos
